    Dual normalization on the standard-form universal cover #

    The positive-height construction normalizes realized sinks. This file implements the dual induction on arrows whose module-theoretic source has nonpositive Bongartz--Gabriel height. It normalizes realized sources while retaining their minimal left almost-split invariant.
